content: Chrome docs: Web NFC launched Chrome 89 Android; NDEFReader.write requires HTTPS, top-level frame, user gesture, and nfc permission. MDN: experimental, not Baseline. iOS Safari/Chrome and desktop Chrome do not expose NDEFReader; iOS needs Core NFC native apps. Write a URL record to /r/{slug}?src=nfc. Do not makeReadOnly in v1 (irreversible). Server must still authorize which slugs a user may write.
